issues: “Nephi” as speaker/narrator is plausible from the surrounding chapter, but the supplied verses do not explicitly name him; scene 1 should preserve this attribution as an inference, not an explicit fact. The vineyard’s reported preparation and yield are properly treated as recounted rather than present action.

The doctrinal note says the supplied verses do not identify the vineyard’s symbolic referent, but 2 Nephi 15:7 explicitly identifies the vineyard as the house of Israel and the men of Judah as its pleasant plant.

The source explicitly reports the Lord's hand stretched against the people and later still stretched out; the note treating this only as figurative language is an interpretation. Depict no visible hand unless the scene adheres strictly to what the text describes.
